div.div: أُبَآءٌ , (T, S, M,) or أُبَآءٌ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ, (K,) A dislike, or loathing, of food: (T, S, M, K:) of the measure فُعَالٌ, (S, M,) with damm, (S, K,) because it is like a disease, and nouns significant of diseases are generally of that measure. (M.) You say, أَخَذَهُ أُبَآءٌ (T, S, M, K) مِنَ الطَّعَامِ (K) He was, or became, taken, or affected, with a dislike, or loathing, of food. (T, S, M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
